entries.name: Glacio
entries.summary: An attribute associated with cooling and freezing.
body: An attribute labels damage and related effects. Read the specific skill instead of assuming every Glacio attack automatically applies a status.

entries.name: Fusion
entries.summary: An attribute associated with heat and ignition.
body: Weapon family and attribute are separate labels. Read a skill’s actual effect before choosing gear for it.

entries.name: Electro
entries.summary: An attribute associated with electrical charge.
body: Only attacks with the relevant effect apply Electro Flare; the attribute label alone is not a full skill description.

entries.name: Aero
body: Aero Erosion is a status associated with certain attacks and effects. Check the skill text rather than expecting every Aero hit to apply it.

entries.name: Spectro
entries.summary: An attribute associated with light and photons.
body: Spectro Frazzle is a stacking effect used by particular abilities. Do not infer an entire rotation from the attribute icon.

entries.name: Havoc
body: Havoc Bane is a particular status effect, not a guarantee attached to every Havoc attack. Read the ability or encounter rule that applies it.

entries.name: Sword
entries.summary: One equipment family with several different secondary-stat options.
body: Choose between actual effects and stat needs. The shared Sword label does not make these items equivalent.

entries.name: Broadblade
entries.summary: A weapon family used by Resonators such as Jiyan and Taoqi.
body: The same family includes different secondary stats. Compare the character’s needs before investing in one.

entries.name: Pistols
entries.summary: A weapon category with damage-focused and utility-focused options.
body: Compare the item effect as well as its stat.

entries.name: Gauntlets
entries.summary: A weapon category whose items can support different stat needs.
body: Match the item to the Resonator’s actual scaling.

entries.name: Rectifier
entries.summary: An equipment family containing both damage and support-oriented stat options.
body: A shared family does not imply the same role. Compare the weapon’s full effect before equipping it.

entries.name: Data Bank
entries.summary: The Terminal system records Echo discoveries and affects Echo collection progression.
body: Check your own Data Bank screen for current level requirements. Repeating an already-recorded rarity is different from discovering a new entry; old level-cap tables may no longer apply.

meta.scope: 12 selected attributes, weapon families and progression terms. This is not a complete character roster, build ranking or item database. Community article text was checked through the search index; no in-game combat test was performed.
